verdict.rationale: Modal's own docs say any containerizable application can be deployed using Python, and they advertise bringing your entire inference stack. That implies custom container environments, but nothing in the pack explicitly documents supplying your own Docker image, registry image or Dockerfile. missing for 10: explicit documentation of bring-your-own Docker image/registry/Dockerfile support, details on custom image definition and environment pinning, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: You can deploy any application that can be containerized, using Python.
Bring your entire inference stack. Modal handles the infrastructure.
